publication.title: Crowdsourced affinity: A matter of fact or experience

source_reading.scope: Abstract and offline-study context, KG construction and affinity methods (§3), complete human-study protocol/results and conclusion (§§5–6).

adjudication.basis: The protocol accepts user-facing guidance/recommendation OR an interactive exploration workflow. The report constructs an actual DBpedia-based typed KG/affinity graph and presents personalized city recommendations with semantic explanations to 37 users. A one-round recommendation workflow satisfies the guidance route; progressive graph navigation is not required.

tasks: Same selected-city profile yields three recommendation/explanation sets

descriptions.interaction: Select appealing cities from randomized list, submit selections, view three top-five recommendation lists with five explanatory concepts, rate them.

descriptions.scalability: 705 city candidates; 29,743 retained neighboring nodes after graph preprocessing.
